```yaml
name: Changelog Enforcer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  changelog-enforcer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: dangoslen/changelog-enforcer@v3
        with:
          skipLabels: "dependencies,documentation,ci"
```

yaml:
name: Changelog Enforcer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  changelog-enforcer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: dangoslen/changelog-enforcer@v3
        with:
          skipLabels: "dependencies,documentation,ci"
